profile.summary: North Valley School is a private, non-profit, non-public school in Santa Rosa, California, serving students in grades 1 to 12. It offers small classes and mental health services, such as individual and group counseling, that follow each student's Individualized Education Program (IEP). It serves youth living at Victor Treatment Centers and day students from nearby school districts.
